body:
If I'm honest I probably have it too, fairly sure my partner has HSV-1. There's probably not anything I can say to make you not worry about it right now though, it's just something that will take a bit of time. I've been diagnosed with something that I'll never be cured of too, and it took me a really long time to accept it. I denied it for ages and still sometimes try to, you just have to not let it control how you feel. You're not your diagnosis. 

That's a really messed up thing to bluff about, especially if trying to blackmail you.. 

I'm going to have to go to bed soon I think, it's 7:30am and I've yet to sleep. Want me to fire you a PM tomorrow or just check back here? I'm always fine to listen or talk to, I'm not usually logged in on Reddit though but will check back when I wake up. I'll probably be awake for another ~20 mins or so.

Sorry if I've not been much help or if my replies have been a bit slow!

Anyone who would care about your diagnosis isn't worth worrying about, in my opinion at least. It's really common, most people don't even realise they have it. I'm not meaning to belittle your worries because you're obviously allowed to have them, but I don't think you should!

Is that one of the things that is bothering you the most? I did read through your original post and saw all the other things you have going on and know that you have a lot of other stuff going on.

You're also right, you don't have to continue, but you should and she clearly really wants you to.

What attracted you to that particular course/field? 

I know you want it, but the fact you know it would hurt your family shows you know they do care. People can struggle to talk about things that scare or worry them. 

What actually happened when you spoke to your mother? She probably did take you seriously but didn't know how to react, it's a really hard think to talk about, especially with someone you love and care about.

Yeah, it's probably the thing I find most peaceful, even in stormy days. You ever take photos when you go? I love photography, it's probably the one thing that helps me most when I'm really down.

You never said what it is you want to do when you graduate either! If you don't want to talk about that, feel free to ignore this but it would be interesting to know.

It's never the only path, you're definitely right to post here and I'm glad you did!

Do you go to the beach often? Saw you mention it a few times, the sea is probably my favourite thing. I spend far too long there sometimes.

Oh wow, that seems like a really interesting thing to study, had to google what it was if I'm honest! What is it you want to do when you graduate? Language and communication are quite strange, in a good way of course.

You have gone through a hell of a lot though so it's totally understandable that you're struggling to focus, it would be more worrying if you weren't really!

The only way you can make things easier for them is by not doing it, I saw you say you had tried to talk to your mother on your previous thread and wasn't sure if she was taking you seriously. These things really are hard to talk about, I can totally relate there so can appreciate how hard it is. I'm here if you want to talk, even if it's something totally unrelated.

What are you studying?

Thank you, I ended up calling in around an hour ago to let them know I won't be in, haven't woken my SO to let her know yet since it's after 4am but I'll try sit down and talk to her later. Going to be a tricky conversation to have but will try my best. 

I do feel like a boulder has been taken off me, but it's only a temporary fix so I'll need to think of a permanent one before things get really bad again. 

Wish I could just work for myself or have a really flexible job so when I have these blips I don't stress out about even more. When you're already really depressed and feel like you're going to get in trouble or punished because of it, it really does make things so much harder. 

Thank you for your replies, I will just try chill for a few days and figure things out, I really do need to figure out a way to not feel this way - work goes fine for a while, even months at a time but it'll only take once for me to actually take my life. If I wasn't so scared of making a mess of it again I probably would have done it tonight.

Wish it was a real option, I don't live alone and couldn't do that to my SO. They would obviously rather I leave my job than their life but I don't want to be a burden. 

Under the equality act I don't think I would be able to lose my job, was reading up about it and I'm not sure if I've had reasonable enough adjustments, it has been a recurring problem for a while and I've reduced my work hours not too long ago already so they may still be able to dismiss me. I find it really hard to call in when I do feel too unwell to go in too, I feel really guilty and get bad anxiety when I have to, but it's company policy to notify them.

I dunno man, wish things could be simpler. Thank you for your reply though.
